assets.name: home-key
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic premium editorial product photograph for FairCoin, an ethical everyday currency website. Subject: a real contemporary house key, satin nickel flat key with plausible notches and a circular keyring holding a small softly worn olive woven fabric loop. Single cohesive key and keyring object only. Floating diagonally at a restrained three-quarter angle, centered and fully visible, occupies 82% of a square canvas. Authentic brushed metal, fine scratches, real woven fibres, accurate proportions. Large soft studio light upper left, gentle dimensional self-shadow, crisp professional macro photography, 85mm lens. Actual transparent background with clean alpha edges, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object. Quiet contemporary 2026 industrial design, no sci-fi. No text, logos, watermark, hands, people, symbols, illustration, clay, toy-like inflated forms or shiny CGI. This is the first asset of a coordinated realistic everyday-object campaign.
